text:
maria_marketing: Quick ops/announce sync — target Bolt release next Thu 08:00 PT. We need: final changelog link (merged), canonical docs staging URL, a 1-line benchmark for the hero, canary + ramp windows, webinar (30m) slot same day, and two A/B email subject lines. Want to lock timeline today. :calendar:

sam_eng: Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/578 (sha `b9f2c4e`). Canary plan: 08:00 PT canary 4m, 15% at 08:04, 45% at 08:12, 100% at 08:28. Fallback tag `bolt-legacy`. Post-rollout support oncall for 20m. Add this rollback if needed: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=6`.

priya_docs: Staging docs live: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/bolt — I've added Quickstart + Migration guide. I'll include an anchor to the migration snippet and a short hero sentence if you want to reuse for the landing. Marketing: paste the canonical URL into the announcement draft when ready.

maria_marketing: Good. For email A/B lines thinking: A) "Bolt: 2.6x lower token cost for long-context apps" B) "Meet Bolt — faster long-context inference, lower cost" — any preference? Also planning VIP email to select partners at +10m.

nico_research: Draft benchmark nugget: "Bolt cuts per-token spend up to 2.6x on 32k-context workloads and reduces p95 latency ~52% at 16k tokens." Running one more validation now; will confirm exact numbers by 06:00 PT tomorrow. If numbers change we'll flag immediately. :microscope:

ev an_pm: I'll lead the webinar (30m) and own the runbook. Webinar slot: same day 10:30 PT — 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Registration landing page: Jordan_growth will build it; marketing please share copy by EOD. For email timing: public email at +5m after full rollout, VIP send at +10m, social at +15m.

priya_docs: Migration config snippet for docs (paste as code block):

```
# example bolt config
model:
  id: redwood-bolt
  quant_mode: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```

maria_marketing: Proposed publish timeline: 08:00 PT canary start, 08:28 full rollout, 08:33 blog + docs live, 08:38 public email (A/B), 08:40 VIP email, 08:45 social posts, 10:30 webinar. Any blockers?

sam_eng: Fine by eng. Note the canary toggles a new fused-quant kernel; ops should run p50/p95 smoke checks on the default route after +5m. Runbook health checks I'll paste in the runbook page (curl & prometheus queries).

nico_research: Confirming benchmark regression now; will post final stat by 06:00 PT. If it's lower we should use conservative phrasing like "up to 2.6x".

ops_bot: Scheduled deployment: release-bolt start=1711468680 canary_window=240s full_rollout=1711469300 CI: checks passed. :white_check_mark:

maria_marketing: Thanks — I'll draft the announcement copy (including both subject lines and hero blurb) and drop it here by EOD for review. Tagging final checklist: changelog link, staging docs URL, confirmed benchmark phrase, runbook + rollback, webinar deck, email A/B. Ping this thread with any last-minute changes. :rocket:
